title: Unsaturated nitrile-conjugated diene copolymer, process for producing the same, and vulcanizable rubber composition
abstract: An unsaturated nitrile-conjugated diene copolymer which is produced by copolymerizing the co-monomers in the presence fo a free-radical initiator by using a molecular weight modifier comprising a C12-C16 alkylthiol compound having at least three tertiary carbon atoms and a sulfur atom directly bonded to at least one of the tertiary carbon atoms, has a Mooney viscosity of 15 to 150, and contains 3-20 wt.% of a low-molecular-weight component having  a number-average molecular weight of 35,000 or less. The copolymer is produced by adding part of the molecular weight modifier to the monomer mixture before the copolymerization and adding the rest of the modifier in the course of the reaction. It is used in combination with a sulfur-base vulcanizer.
